last_scene.summary: Arlequino spent several hours walking through the capital while performing songs on violin. After every three songs he announced today's free 19:00 concert at the small combat yard. Four three-song street sets were completed across different busy areas. Reactions were mixed and local: fighters reacted most strongly to familiar martial refrains from songs such as 'Герои' and 'Головы с плеч'; lighter material such as 'Авантюрист' drew clapping and teasing; some passers-by ignored him or moved on. No royal or citywide response is assumed. Street tips totaled 17s64c, with no expenses. Personal cash increased from 18g99s60c to 19g17s24c.
